newsitem.title: UK: Racal unit wins 11 mln stg Asian Navy order.
newsitem.headline: Racal unit wins 11 mln stg Asian Navy order.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc said its Racal Radio Ltd unit has won a strategic communications contract from an Asian Navy worth around 11 million stg.

The contract, for its Racal Adaptive Communications Equipment (RACE) system, is for modernising the country's naval communications system and represents the largest Asian order for the advanced system. Racal did not disclose which country was involved.
Deliveries will start immediately and be completed in around 18 months, the company said in a statement.

Another unit, Racal-Thorn Defence, said it has been awarded a contract worth around 4.0 million stg by Arab International Optronics -- partly owned by the Egyptian Ministry of Defence -- to refurbish and upgrade 12 Egyptian army Cymbeline mortar locating radars.
The order represents the biggest single award for Cymbeline for over 10 years.
